_comment: Turns the host sends that the user did not write (DEC-059). Shapes observed in a real session on 2026-10-18, text sanitized; each matches the delegated NL map, so a gate that classified it would arm. The user turns name their command explicitly: since DEC-068 only an explicit command arms the gate. `payload` fields are merged into the UserPromptSubmit payload.

host.name: subagent hand-back
host.prompt:
Another Claude session sent a message:
<agent-message from="a0000000000000001">
[Subagent hand-back] The text below is the final report of a subagent.
  I translated the release notes. Please verify the result and run the grep; the analyze step found nothing to audit.
</agent-message>

host.name: hand-back inside a reminder with an id
host.prompt:
<system-reminder id="f0000000000000001">
Another Claude session sent a message while you were working:
<agent-message from="a0000000000000004">
  Reproduction report: tolong cek hasil dan analisa kenapa gate memblokir.
</agent-message>
</system-reminder id="f0000000000000001">

host.name: hand-back while the main agent works
host.prompt:
Another Claude session sent a message while you were working:
<agent-message from="a0000000000000005">
  Selesai. Tolong cek hasil dan analisa kenapa test gagal.
</agent-message>

host.name: hand-back without the opening line
host.prompt:
<agent-message from="a0000000000000002">
  Done. Tolong cek hasil terjemahan; analisa kenapa gate memblokir Bash.
</agent-message>

host.name: task notification inside a system reminder
host.prompt:
<system-reminder>
[SYSTEM NOTIFICATION - NOT USER INPUT]
This is an automated background-task event, NOT a message from the user.
<task-notification>
<task-id>b0000001</task-id>
<status>completed</status>
<summary>Background command "Run delegated verify, analyze audit" completed</summary>
</task-notification>
</system-reminder>

host.name: task notification after a system reminder
host.prompt:
<system-reminder>
Reminder text.
</system-reminder>
<task-notification>
<summary>Agent "Translate docs, then audit" finished</summary>
</task-notification>

host.name: system notification without the reminder wrapper
host.prompt:
[SYSTEM NOTIFICATION - NOT USER INPUT]
<task-notification>
<summary>analyze audit completed</summary>
</task-notification>

user.name: user prompt quoting a hand-back
user.prompt: /.analyze kenapa pesan "Another Claude session sent a message:" memicu gate

user.name: user text after a system reminder
user.prompt:
<system-reminder>
Reminder text.
</system-reminder>
/.analyze kenapa gate ini memblokir
